mapper.sql: id, user_id, note_id, order_no, bucket, object_key, url, thumb_object_key, thumb_url, mime, media_type, size_bytes, width, height, duration_ms, playback_object_key, playback_url, playback_low_object_key, playback_low_url, exif_latitude, exif_longitude, status, failure_reason, failed_at, publish_status, publish_attempts, last_publish_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media (user_id, note_id, order_no, bucket, object_key, url, mime, media_type, size_bytes, width, height, duration_ms, playback_object_key, playback_url, playback_low_object_key, playback_low_url, exif_latitude, exif_longitude, status, publish_status, publish_attempts) VALUES (#{userId}, #{noteId}, #{orderNo}, #{bucket}, #{objectKey}, #{url}, #{mime}, #{mediaType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{width}, #{height}, #{durationMs}, #{playbackObjectKey}, #{playbackUrl}, #{playbackLowObjectKey}, #{playbackLowUrl}, #{exifLatitude}, #{exifLongitude}, #{status}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM media WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE media SET status = #{status}, thumb_object_key = #{thumbObjectKey}, thumb_url = #{thumbObjectKey}, width = #{width}, height = #{height}, failure_reason = NULL, failed_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0

UPDATE media SET status = 12, thumb_object_key = #{thumbObjectKey}, thumb_url = #{thumbObjectKey}, width = #{width}, height = #{height}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, playback_object_key = #{playbackObjectKey}, playback_url = #{playbackObjectKey}, playback_low_object_key = #{playbackLowObjectKey}, playback_low_url = #{playbackLowObjectKey}, failure_reason = NULL, failed_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND media_type = 1 AND status = 11
UPDATE media SET status = 2, thumb_object_key = NULL, thumb_url = NULL, width = NULL, height = NULL, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, failed_at = #{failedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0

UPDATE media SET status = 13, thumb_object_key = NULL, thumb_url = NULL, width = NULL, height = NULL, duration_ms = NULL, playback_object_key = NULL, playback_url = NULL, playback_low_object_key = NULL, playback_low_url = NULL, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, failed_at = #{failedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND media_type = 1 AND status = 11

UPDATE media SET publish_attempts = publish_attempts + 1, last_publish_at = #{attemptedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND publish_status = 0 AND publish_attempts < 3 AND (last_publish_at IS NULL OR last_publish_at < DATE_SUB(#{attemptedAt}, INTERVAL 30 SECOND))
UPDATE media SET publish_status = 1, failure_reason = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND publish_status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM media WHERE note_id IS NULL AND status IN (0, 11) AND publish_status = 0 AND publish_attempts < 3 AND (last_publish_at IS NULL OR last_publish_at < #{before}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM media WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND note_id IS NULL
DELETE FROM media WHERE id = #{id} AND note_id IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE media SET note_id = #{noteId}, order_no = #{orderNo} WHERE id = #{mediaId} AND note_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM media WHERE note_id IN #{nid} ORDER BY note_id ASC, order_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM media WHERE note_id IS NULL AND status IN (0, 2, 11, 13, 14) AND created_at < #{before} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
